description: Defines how users make annotations on verses.

main.description: An individual comment on a group of verses

commentaryId.description: References a commentary (a named collection of annotations) if one is associated

verses.description: The IDs of the verses this comment is on

comment.description: Supports markdown with extensions. If not provided, this annotation is considered a highlight.

color.description: The color of the highlight. If not provided, this annotation is considered only a comment.
